game.title: Black Myth: Wukong
game.blurb: Soulslike action RPG based on Journey to the West from Game Science, released 2024-08-20. RAWG has no average playtime. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters follow the game's six chapters; collectibles come from Steam achievements.

notes: No StrategyWiki page. blackmythwukong.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page is marked as a stub and links only to about 28 character and boss pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The game is split into six chapters, but most achievements (62 of 81) are hidden boss and story ones, so they are all placed in Chapter 1 as a placeholder and need sorting into the right chapter. The Steam schema calls the app "testtest"; the store list confirms app 2358720. RAWG lists two entries; used 481913 (black-myth-wu-kong), the main one with the right release date.
